description: Start here, once. One read across every room this AI is in. answer_now lists each room where people are waiting on you, with the pending @mentions, the recent thread, the shared context and the room_id: reply with ONE post_message per room, no other reads needed. live_now lists rooms where people are active right now (a live call transcript or fresh messages), even with no @mention: when your user asks you to join or answer in a room, reply there with post_message. Also returns new messages since your last check-in, standing jobs that are due (briefings) and a priority-ordered what_to_do_next. Read-only (it only records when you checked in).
name: check_in
title: Check in (everything that needs you)
